action.fallback: At proactive-only pressure, eligibility veto, missing trace, unsupported advice, budget exhaustion, or a missed recovery margin does not stop a fit while the unchanged hard gates pass. Existing hard pressure still fails closed unless the full 512 MB recovery target is restored.
action.method: POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED on recent compressed byte ranges recorded from the existing open PyArrow reader; no parquet footer is reopened during recovery
action.recheck: Reread resource snapshot and memory.stat. Keep the original 25% plus 512 MB recovery target. If a proactive-only attempt misses that target but the consistent post-advice host and cgroup samples still pass every hard gate, record the miss and continue. If hard pressure existed at trigger time, the full recovery target is required; otherwise fail closed.

budget_derivation.coverage_assumption: Each fit epoch reads no more than one complete pass of both pinned raw files; one extra complete pair pass bounds profile/setup exposure even though profile is capped at 23 batches; one more pair pass bounds identity-hash fallback; prediction export reads no more than one complete valid file. This sizes a worst-case advice budget, not a prediction of cache eviction.
budget_derivation.hash_path_note: The raw identity fallback independently streams through its existing bounded POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED path; one full pair pass is nevertheless included in this reserve.
budget_derivation.rate_and_failure_policy: Reserve at most one 768000000 byte advice episode per 20.0 seconds and 320 total; the existing memory.stat eligibility and post-advice gate-plus-512 MB recheck apply to every event. A proactive-only margin miss is recorded and may continue only while the unchanged hard gates pass; hard-pressure recovery remains fail closed.
